description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for a flexible logging system in Android development. It specifies a method for printing log messages to different targets, possibly forming a chain of log handlers.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for logging nodes that can output log data to various targets and can be chained together.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable object.
